name: Gateway Down or Packet Loss
description: Catches dpinger gateway alarms on OPNsense and pfSense (high latency or packet loss) and gateways dropped from a gateway group. A gateway coming back is not matched.
match_pattern: : Alarm latency \d+us stddev \d+us loss \d+%|(?:is down|has packet loss|has high latency), omitting from routing group|\bALERT: \S+ \(Addr: |>>> Gateway alarm: \S+ \(Addr:\S* Alarm:1\b
